session: Session 68 Day 2 — Q-Lead 신규 지시 #2 (PENDING size_bias_check 처리)
purpose: Q-Lead 지시 #2 PENDING 처리. STR_1661 V2 S2 profiling size-bias 분석 — Top 20 종목의 market cap 분포가 universe 대비 large-cap 편중 여부 확인. S3 TDC 측정 전 prerequisite.

methodology.step_1_top_20_extraction: Each month t: select Top 20 tickers by Score descending (LambdaRank prediction)
methodology.step_2_universe_stats: Each month t: universe size median / q25 / q75 compute
methodology.step_3_top20_size_stats: Top 20 size median / q25 / q75 compute
methodology.step_4_ratio_analysis: Top 20 size_median / Universe size_median ratio per month
methodology.step_5_percentile_analysis: Each Top 20 ticker's size percentile within monthly universe (1~100 scale)

top20_vs_universe_median_size_ratio.interpretation: Top 20 median size는 universe median과 비슷 수준 (ratio 0.66~1.14). random sampling 대비 systematic large-cap bias 없음 — ML signal이 size에 무관한 neutral selection.

top20_percentile_within_universe.interpretation: Top 20 평균 size percentile 52.5% — universe median과 거의 동일. Top 30% (large-cap) 편중 35% (random uniform 30% 대비 +5%p, 미미한 large-cap 약간 선호). ML V2는 size-neutral strategy에 가까움.

size_neutrality_verdict: **SIZE_NEUTRAL** — ML V2 LambdaRank signal은 large-cap systematic bias 없음. small/mid/large cap 균등 분포 선택.

comparison_with_expectations.expected: ML feature engineering (momentum/value/quality 조합)은 대개 size 관련 factor 포함 → large-cap bias 경향 (mean percentile 60~75% 범위)
comparison_with_expectations.explanation: LambdaRank objective의 pairwise ordering 학습이 절대 return level 아닌 rank를 학습 → size level 자체와 독립. mi_top_n=50 features 중 size factor importance 낮은 것으로 추정.

implications_for_s3.liquidity_concern: size-neutral 은 small-cap 포함 가능 → 유동성 필터 LIQ_THRESHOLD=2e8 (C10) 엄수 필수
implications_for_s3.tdc_measurement_impact: STR_1661 V2 size-neutral이면 STR_1631 (Consensus C19 기반, large-cap 선호 경향) 대비 자동 orthogonality 확보 가능성 높음
implications_for_s3.expected_tdc_update: s3_tdc_premeasurement H_1693 vs STR_1661 V2 TDC 0.10~0.25 예측 유지 (size-neutral 확인으로 재확인)
implications_for_s3.parent_child_relationship: STR_1656 MLRA parent 관계는 ML family 공유로 TDC 높음 예상 (0.50~0.70), 그러나 V2 LambdaRank는 parent의 reg:squarederror 대비 objective 다름 → 상대적 orthogonality 확보

implications_for_governor_pg1_admission.size_distribution: size-neutral 선택은 portfolio diversification 관점 긍정적
implications_for_governor_pg1_admission.concentration_risk_reduction: large-cap 집중 없으므로 Top 10 HHI (시가총액 기준) 낮게 분포 예상
implications_for_governor_pg1_admission.role_alignment: ML_predictive role (v55 6-taxonomy)에 size-neutral이 적합 — pure prediction alpha로 size factor 오염 없음

s2_profile_verdict_update.overall_s2_verdict: CONDITIONAL_PASS 유지 — three_period PASS + rolling_drift UNSTABLE (time-varying feature 정상) + stress_ic STRONG + **size_bias SIZE_NEUTRAL** 추가. advance_to_s3: TRUE
